input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: Explore: new research-algorithm venture fdr-multiple-testing (BH, BY, BKY, Storey q-values, Bonferroni, Sidak, Holm, Hochberg, e-BH)
errors: Two of my own test expectations were wrong at first (Holm keeps 3, not 4, on the BH 1995 example; the first e-value reference was too weak to reject at 0.01). Fixed the tests, not the engine, after recomputing by hand.
A Python edit script asserted before writing a sibling page test, leaving one sibling HTML changed and its test not; caught and fixed before commit.
integrity_issues: The BH 1995 paper could not be fetched (dcscience.net refused by the proxy), so the example p-values were taken from statsmodels' test_multi.py, which labels them 'example from BKY'; data/SOURCE.md says so and the page attributes the 4/8/0.0649 counts to statsmodels' tests rather than claiming to have read the paper.

doc_friction.issue: python3 platform/ci/run_workflow_locally.py --for-changes and run_venture_tests.py with several slugs both outlast the 120 s tool timeout here; worth saying 'start with run_in_background' next to them, as is already said for node --test.

The definition-of-done table does not mention the sibling-footer convention (each research tool's footer links the others and its page.test asserts it), so adding a tool means editing four other ventures; found by reading the survival-analysis PR's stat.

deviations.why: It asks for tests against 'another implementation's output'; for Storey q-values I could not run the third-party qvalue PyPI package (the auto-mode classifier blocked running downloaded code), so the reference is pi0 x statsmodels' fdr_bh values, using the identity q = pi0 x BH-adjusted.
deviations.did: Used the identity with statsmodels as the independent part; documented in reference.py and README.
deviations.result: q-values match to 1e-12 at three lambdas; the pi0 formula itself is checked against a numpy reimplementation, not a third-party library.

notes: Explore idea: fifth research-algorithms-as-tools venture, fdr-multiple-testing (candidate listed in portfolio/research-tools/README.md). Eight p-value corrections plus e-BH, engine/CLI/page/agent call; checked against statsmodels 0.15.0 to 1e-12. Seeded simulation (eval/simulate.mjs) found Storey q-values reach FDR 0.109 at a 0.05 target under pairwise correlation 0.5 (BH 0.029): pi0 (truth 0.9) fell below 0.5 in 26% of runs, FDP 0.41 in those runs. Checks run: venture node --test 39/39, sibling page tests, Playwright smoke at 1100/375 px, post frontmatter and links. No agent doc in docs/reports: the README's Verification section and the post carry what the next run needs.
